# coolify_notification_settings (Resource)

Team notification settings for one channel (docs: knowledge-base/notifications). Singleton per channel: creating the resource adopts the channel's settings, destroying it disables the channel. Event names for `events` follow the Coolify UI: `deployment_success`, `deployment_failure`, `status_change`, `backup_success`, `backup_failure`, `scheduled_task_success`, `scheduled_task_failure`, `docker_cleanup_success`, `docker_cleanup_failure`, `server_disk_usage`, `server_reachable`, `server_unreachable`, `server_patch`, `traefik_outdated`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "coolify_notification_settings" "discord" {
  channel     = "discord"
  enabled     = true
  webhook_url = var.discord_webhook

  events = {
    deployment_failure = true
    backup_failure     = true
    server_unreachable = true
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `channel` (String) `email`, `discord`, `slack`, `telegram`, `pushover` or `webhook`. Changing it forces replacement.

### Optional

- `enabled` (Boolean) Enable the channel. Defaults to the current instance value.
- `events` (Map of Boolean) Per-event toggles for this channel (see the list above). Only the listed keys are managed; others keep their instance values.
- `pushover_api_token` (String, Sensitive) Pushover API token (pushover channel).
- `pushover_user_key` (String, Sensitive) Pushover user key (pushover channel).
- `smtp_from_address` (String) Sender address (email channel).
- `smtp_from_name` (String) Sender display name (email channel).
- `smtp_host` (String) SMTP host (email channel).
- `smtp_password` (String, Sensitive) SMTP password (email channel).
- `smtp_port` (Number) SMTP port (email channel).
- `smtp_recipients` (String) Comma-separated recipients (email channel).
- `smtp_username` (String) SMTP username (email channel).
- `telegram_chat_id` (String) Telegram chat id (telegram channel).
- `telegram_token` (String, Sensitive) Telegram bot token (telegram channel).
- `webhook_url` (String, Sensitive) Webhook URL (discord, slack and webhook channels).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import coolify_notification_settings.discord discord

# One of: email, discord, slack, telegram, pushover, webhook.
```
